notes: empty function: the whole body is ret (empty virtual methods, no-op callbacks); excludes members with unlisted code in their padding
returns zero: xor eax, eax; ret (false, null, 0); excludes members with unlisted code in their padding
returns a constant: mov eax, imm32; ret, zero-extended to rax; excludes members with unlisted code in their padding
64-bit field getter: mov rax, [rdi+K]; ret, one replacement per offset; negative offsets excluded
32-bit field getter: mov eax, [rdi+K]; ret, zero-extended to rax; negative offsets excluded
16-bit field getter: movzx eax, word [rdi+K]; ret; negative offsets excluded
8-bit field getter: movzx eax, byte [rdi+K]; ret (mov al, [rdi+K] keeps rax's upper bytes and is excluded)
member or base address: lea rax, [rdi+K]; ret, reads no memory
first-field getter: mov rax, [rdi]; ret
first 32-bit field getter: mov eax, [rdi]; ret, zero-extended to rax
64-bit field setter: mov [rdi+K], rsi; ret; leaves rax
32-bit field setter: mov [rdi+K], esi; ret; leaves rax
16-bit field setter: mov [rdi+K], si; ret; leaves rax
delegate call: when the method at rdi+0x10 and the object at rdi+8 are set, the method with the qword at rsi+0x10 and the dword at rdi+0x28
delegate call: when the method at rdi+0x10 and the object at rdi+8 are set, the method with the qword at rsi+8 and the dword at rdi+0x28
delegate call: when the method at rdi+0x10 and the object at rdi+8 are set, the method with the dword at rdi+0x20, the other arguments as they came
delegate call: when the method at rdi+0x20 is set, the method on the object at rdi+0x18 with the second argument as it came and the dword at rdi+0x40
delegate call: when bit 6 of the byte at rdi+0xb is set, the method at rdi+0x20 on the object at rdi+0x10 with the dword at rdi+0x18
delegate call: when rsi, the pointer at rsi+8 and the object at rdi+8 are set, the method at rdi+0x10 with that pointer plus 0x28 and the dword at rdi+0x20
delegate thunk: the method at rdi+0x18 on the object at rdi+0x10, the other arguments as they came
delegate thunk: the method at rdi+0x20 on the object at rdi+0x18, the other arguments as they came
delegate thunk: the method at rdi+0x28 on the object at rdi+0x20, the other arguments as they came
delegate call: when bit 4 of the byte at rsi+0x3d is set, the method at rdi+0x58 on the object at rdi+0x50 with the dword at rdi+0x68
8-bit field setter: mov [rdi+K], sil; ret; leaves rax
first-field setter: mov [rdi], rsi; ret; leaves rax
first 32-bit field setter: mov [rdi], esi; ret; leaves rax
identity: mov rax, rdi; ret
returns the second argument: mov rax, rsi; ret
returns 0.0f: vxorps xmm0, xmm0, xmm0; ret (all of xmm0 zero)
